wrong.sentence: In 2025 warehouse headcount grew by 7%.
Harbourline owned 1,840 trailers at the end of 2025.
Insurance cost Harbourline £14.2m in 2025.
wrong.why: The Document gives £14.2m as fuel costs for 2025, not insurance cost.

wrong.sentence: Late deliveries fell 18% from 2024.
Customers took 2.4 days on average to pay their invoices in 2025.
wrong.why: The Documents do not say how long customers took to pay their invoices. The only 2.4-day figure is the average delivery time from order to doorstep in the Harbourline Logistics 2025 annual review, which is a different measure.

wrong.sentence: Rail partners carried Harbourline's freight 96 million kilometres in 2025.
wrong.why: The fleet drove 96 million kilometres over the year.

wrong.sentence: Water use per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
Earnings were 6.5p per share.
wrong.why: The Documents give a proposed final dividend of 6.5p per share, not earnings per share. No passage states earnings of 6.5p per share.

wrong.sentence: Free cash flow came to £38m in 2025.
Felixstowe depot's space occupancy was 94% in 2025.
wrong.why: The 94% in the Documents is an on-time rate, not space occupancy.

right.sentence: Harbourline employed 1,840 drivers at the end of 2025.
An average delivery took 2.4 days in 2025.
The fleet covered 96 million kilometres in 2025.
Carbon emissions per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
The final dividend is 6.5p per share.
right.why: The Document forecasts this but doesn’t say it will happen

swaps.sentence: Fuel costs were £38m and capital expenditure was £14.2m in 2025.

In 2025 Felixstowe's on-time rate was 89% and Leeds's was 94%.
An average delivery took 6.5 days, and the final dividend is 2.4p per share.
Customer complaints fell 11% and carbon emissions per tonne fell 18% in 2025.
